messages:
Elena: Heads-up  Partnership ops wants an ops-handbook walkthrough for new SIs (onboarding checklist, lab access, certification flow, marketplace tile). Can eng, ops, and PM join a 45-minute session tomorrow 09:30 PT?
Samir: Im in. Suggest we focus the session on three things: 1) self-serve lab access (provisioning + creds), 2) certification exam steps & scoring, 3) publishing/badging pipeline and rollback.
Jules: Works for me. Ill update the handbook draft with the exam rubric and a short runbook for the badge flip. Also want to add telemetry SLOs partners can expect post-cert.
mark-ops-bot: Flag: `si_onboard_handbook_v2` (doc draft). Access: https://docs.redwood.internal/si-handbook/v2 (partners-only preview).
Elena: Nice. Partner wants an example of the partner-facing incident message and an ops-run simulation during the session. Keep it short - partners only want practical steps.
Samir: For the badge flip, ops will pre-provision partner-only badge and then flip to public at publish. Snippet well demo:```bash
# set badge public
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  https://internal-api/flags/si_badge_public -d '{"value":true}'
# rollback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  https://internal-api/flags/si_badge_public -d '{"value":false}'
```
Jules: For the cert exam, proposed pass threshold is 80% and a timed practical (30 min) run on staging with a checklist: deploy sample app, verify latency under 200ms p50, pass 5/6 integration smoke tests. Ill paste the checklist into the deck.
partner-lead: Can you include a shipping option for on-prem lab kits (option A: ship standard GPU kit, option B: cloud credits + remote lab access)? Also include roughly how long onboarding takes (2-3 weeks typical).
Elena: Good call. Add both options and a contact point for logistics (partner-ops). We should also surface the marketplace SKU mapping format and an example tile payload.
Samir: Ill bring SKU mapping example and a simple JSON payload to validate ingestion during the rehearsal.
Jules: Timeline for session: 09:30 intros, 09:35 handbook walkthrough, 09:50 badge flip demo + simulated rollback, 10:05 cert exam rubric + Qs, 10:20 action items & next steps.
mark-ops-bot: Calendar event created: "SI Ops Handbook walkthrough" 09:30 PT  invites: Elena, Samir, Jules, partner-lead, partner-ops.
Elena: Action items before the session: Jules  paste checklist in doc; Samir  prepare badge flip demo script and SKU payload; partner-lead  confirm whether they want shipped kit or cloud credits. Please drop materials in the calendar invite by EOD.
Samir: Will upload demo script and a small ingestion test by 17:00 PT.
Jules: Checklist and rubric uploaded. See you tomorrow, please be punctual.
partner-lead: Thanks team, looking forward to a practical session.
